curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what lengthens stopping distance, keeping pace with traffic, zipper merges and slow zones.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per idea; contrast card for the zipper merge.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through a traffic stop from the lights behind you to the ticket: pulling over, conduct inside the car, documents, stepping out, outcomes, contesting, and signing.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per step; contrast card for signing versus admitting guilt.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on behavior during a traffic stop.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain sharing the road, motorcycle lane filtering, left-turn crashes with riders, and bicycles as vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast card for lane filtering limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on bicycles and motorcycles.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Define No Zones and cover backing trucks, tailgating and side blind spots.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per No Zone rule.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach stop bars, passing trucks, wide right turns, runaway truck ramps and runaway trucks.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for returning after a pass and wide turns.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach bus stops and right of way, school zones, the two-stage school bus lights and the twenty-foot stop.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast card for yellow versus red lights.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach which road layouts require oncoming traffic to stop for a school bus.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each layout; contrast card for the rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on road layouts and school buses.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach light rail weight and turning, riders and hidden trains, crossing signals and gates, overhead wires, crossbucks, and vehicles that must stop at crossings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast card for crossbucks versus gates.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec12-m01..sec12-m08; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

domain_emphasis_check.domain: Traffic flow, traffic stops, sharing the road, trucks and school buses

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
